article.title: BAP Condemns Alexander Reid Ross and New Lines Magazine for Their Attack on Sahel Solidarity — The Black Alliance for Peace
article.content: Ross’s article exposes the bankruptcy of a Eurocentric worldview that treats African resistance to Western domination as evidence of foreign manipulation. He directs his suspicion at Africans challenging Western domination and at the people who organize in solidarity with them. That is political cover for imperialism abroad and ideological ammunition for a U.S. ruling class advancing a fascist agenda domestically. His guilt-by-association tactics fit neatly into the campaign to cast anti-war and anti-imperialist organizing as a threat. Further, in the article, he uses the speculations of unnamed attendees of a public event, spurious claims of financial associations, and conspiratorial language around organizational collaborations to cast doubt about the aims of the various groups who are in solidarity with the struggle for authentic popular sovereignty in the AES and throughout the African continent. If Reid Ross and other “journalists” are legitimately concerned about the people(s)-centered human rights of the peoples of the AES, they should dedicate more energy to investigating and exposing the relationships of corporate and state imperialist interests that have destabilized the region for years and aim to restrain the will of the masses. For the Black Alliance for Peace, solidarity with the peoples of the Sahel and the African continent means not bowing to the colonial perspectives of Eurocentric observers. This solidarity takes our political responsibilities seriously, based on real-world political realities and the impacts of imperialism on the people and states throughout Africa, and is determined by what position best advances the sovereignty, self-determination, dignity, and material well-being of the peoples of any nation, state, or community. We understand that imperialism is not simply another form of authoritarianism; it is a system of international domination headed by the U.S./EU/NATO axis of domination. As such, anti-imperialists must oppose imperialism as it operates against the people of any nation, and support authentic efforts to develop popular sovereignty and self-determination in resistance to imperialism. Liberation in the Sahel and throughout the continent will come from the people themselves, not from abstract musings and pedestrian desk research of Eurocentric pundits. The Black Alliance for Peace continues to stand with the peoples of the Sahel in the global African struggle for popular sovereignty and self-determination.
